  • Reference

    Normalise all columns of a salary table

    normalize_all.Rd

    Wrapper (orchestrator) function that sequentially applies all normalisation rules specific to the salary dataset (salary_tbl).

    normalize_all(data)

    Arguments

    data

    The data.frame (salary_tbl) to normalise.

    Value

    The fully normalised data.frame, ready for analysis.

    Details

    This function transforms the following columns:

    • Location (company_location, employee_residence): ISO2 normalisation and creation of regional groupings.

    • Job title (job_title): Standardisation of job titles.

    • Remote work (remote_ratio): Numeric cleaning of the remote work ratio.

    • Company size (company_size): Conversion to an ordered factor.

    • Employment type (employment_type): Standardisation.

    • Experience (experience_level): Conversion to an ordered factor.

    Note

    This function depends on global mapping variables (e.g. mapping_total, levels_iso2, size_mapping, etc.) that must be loaded in the environment before execution.

    See also

    normalize_factor, normalize_remote_ratio

    Other Normalization functions: normalize_factor(), normalize_remote_ratio()

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# This example does not run automatically because it requires
# the mapping objects (mapping_total, levels_iso2, etc.)
# to be present in the global environment.

df_clean <- normalize_all(salary_tbl_raw)
} # }
